name: mame05
title: MAME 0.5 (DJGPP + Allegro, 1997)
_doc: The last MAME release PRISM builds, and the widest: 0.5 adds Donkey Kong Jr, the GALAXIAN family and its clones, Pisces, War of the Bugs, Moon Cresta, The End and a Japanese Irem game -- so the corpus stops being Pac-Man-family Z80 boards plus Wizard of Wor. Its own whatsnew.txt names two source changes worth knowing before reading a failure: readroms() now allows SCATTER LOADING of one ROM (needed for Donkey Kong Jr), which moved the end-of-array marker to size==0, and the AY-3-8910 emulation was reverted to the older code. Both are the same class of thing as 0.4 moving the joystick across the osd_joy_* boundary: the shape of the data, not the language.
_units: The makefile's OBJS list, in its order. obj/osdepend.o has its own rule pointing at src/msdos/msdos.c -- MAME's own DOS backend, compiled rather than replaced.
_include: The makefile's -Isrc -Isrc/z80, plus src/msdos for the osdepend rule. The directory on disk is `Z80` with a capital Z, and the makefile spells its -I lowercase -- harmless on the case-insensitive filesystem the archive was built for, and named here in the case it actually has so the target is not a guess about the host.
_defines: The makefile passes -DX86_ASM -DLSB_FIRST. X86_ASM is NOT set here: it selects the x86 assembly path, the same choice as Quake's id386=0 and Heretic's #ifndef __WATCOMC__.
